wikipedia.extract: Calyptomena is a genus containing three green birds in the broadbill family Calyptomenidae that are found in Southeast Asia.
wikipedia.title: Calyptomena

wikipedia.extract: "Pelargopsis" was also invalidly given to Pelargopappus, a genus of fossil secretarybirds. Pelargopsis is a genus of tree kingfishers that are resident in tropical south Asia from India and Sri Lanka to Indonesia.
wikipedia.title: Pelargopsis

commonNames.name: Maués Marmoset
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

commonNames.name: Rio Maués marmoset
commonNames.source: Catálogo Taxonômico da Fauna do Brasil

wikipedia.extract: The Maués marmoset (Mico mauesi) is a marmoset endemic to Brazil. It is found only on the west bank of the Maués Açu River, in the Amazonas state.
wikipedia.title: Maués marmoset

wikipedia.extract: Cranes are a type of large bird with long legs and necks in the biological family Gruidae of the order Gruiformes. The family has 15 species placed in four genera which are Antigone, Balearica, Leucogeranus, and Grus.
wikipedia.title: Crane (bird)

wikipedia.extract: The tooth-billed pigeons are the only genus (Didunculus) of the subfamily Didunculinae, in the pigeon and dove family, (Columbidae). It has no close living relatives, but it has been shown to be genetically close to the dodo, and the genus name Didunculus means "little dodo".
wikipedia.title: Didunculus

wikipedia.extract: Onychoprion is a genus of four species of terns in the family Laridae. The genus name is from Ancient Greek onux, "claw" or "nail", and prion, "saw".
wikipedia.title: Onychoprion

wikipedia.extract: Theropithecus is a genus of primates in the family Cercopithecidae. It contains a single living species, the gelada (Theropithecus gelada), native to the Ethiopian Highlands.
wikipedia.title: Theropithecus

wikipedia.extract: Talegalla is a genus of bird in the family Megapodiidae. First described by René Primevère Lesson in 1828, it contains the following species: Red-billed brushturkey (Talegalla cuvieri) Black-billed brushturkey (Talegalla fuscirostris) Collared brushturkey (Talegalla jobiensis) The name Talegalla is a combination of taleve, the French word for swamphen, and gallus, the Latin word for "cock".
wikipedia.title: Talegalla

wikipedia.extract: The black partridge (Melanoperdix niger), also known as the black wood partridge, is a small (up to 27 cm long) partridge with a thick bill, grey legs and dark brown iris. It is the only member of the monotypic genus Melanoperdix.
wikipedia.title: Black partridge

wikipedia.extract: Homo heidelbergensis () is a controversial and somewhat poorly defined species of archaic human from the Middle Pleistocene of Europe and Africa, as well as potentially Asia depending on the taxonomic convention used. The species-level classification of Homo during the Middle Pleistocene is controversial, called the "muddle in the middle", owing to the wide anatomical range of variation that populations exhibited during this time.
wikipedia.title: Homo heidelbergensis

wikipedia.extract: Delphinornis is an extinct genus of penguins that lived around the middle Eocene to the middle Miocene in Antarctica.
wikipedia.title: Delphinornis

wikipedia.extract: Gallirallus is a genus of rails that live in the Australasian-Pacific region. The genus is characterised by an ability to colonise relatively small and isolated islands and thereafter to evolve flightless forms, many of which became extinct following Polynesian settlement.
wikipedia.title: Gallirallus

wikipedia.extract: Pachylemur is an extinct, giant lemur most closely related to the ruffed lemurs of genus Varecia. Two species are known, Pachylemur insignis and Pachylemur jullyi, although there is some doubt as to whether or not they may actually be the same species.
wikipedia.title: Pachylemur

commonNames.name: Isabel's Saki
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: Isabel's saki (Pithecia isabela) is a species of saki monkey, a type of New World monkey. It is endemic to a small portion of northern Peru.
wikipedia.title: Isabel's saki

commonNames.name: Amazonian Black Howler Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Amazon black howler (Alouatta nigerrima) is a species of howler monkey, a type of New World monkey, endemic to the south-central Amazon in Brazil. Until 2001, most authorities included it as a subspecies (or simply a taxonomically insignificant variation) of the red-handed howler, though its distinction had already been pointed out much earlier.
wikipedia.title: Amazon black howler
